title.en: Age rating: answer Shared Location and Dating and Relationships questions
title.tr: Yaş derecelendirmesi: Shared Location ve Dating and Relationships soruları

description.en: New age rating content descriptors in App Store Connect since 2026-11-16. Dating and Relationships gives a minimum rating of 18+. Shared Location may not change the minimum rating in some regions. Declarations are required when submitting an update or changing the questionnaire, and every app must complete them by 2027-01-12.
description.tr: Yeni descriptor'lar 16 Kasım 2026'dan beri; Dating and Relationships en az 18+. Bütün uygulamalar 12 Ocak 2027'ye kadar cevaplamalı; güncelleme gönderirken hemen gerekir.

requirement.condition: Required now for updates and questionnaire changes; required for all apps by the deadline.

sources.title: Apple Developer News: new age rating content descriptors (2026-11-02)
sources.quote: All apps must have these declarations completed by January 12, 2027.

rules.notes: Dates and descriptors verified. The App Store Connect API attribute names for the two new descriptors are not yet verified; until they are, the readiness check may need to fall back to an assisted step.

title.en: Brazil: A16 for Shared Location, A18 for Dating and Relationships
title.tr: Brezilya: Shared Location için A16, Dating and Relationships için A18

description.en: In Brazil, local regulations require an A16 rating for Shared Location and an A18 rating for Dating and Relationships. Developers who believe a lower rating applies (for example parent and child location sharing) can request an official rating from Brazil's Ministry of Justice and Public Security (MJSP); once verified it is shown on the Brazil App Store.

sources.title: Apple Developer News: new age rating content descriptors (2026-11-02)

title.en: China mainland: complete AIGC and Security Assessment declarations
title.tr: Çin anakarası: AIGC ve Security Assessment beyanlarını tamamla

description.en: Every app on the China mainland App Store must answer the declarations (Yes if the features are offered there, No if not offered, disabled or geoblocked). Until compliance information is verified the app is released elsewhere but not in China mainland. Existing apps must have verified declarations by 2027-01-31 to remain available. Account Holder or Admin completes it.
description.tr: Çin'de dağıtılan her uygulama beyanları (Evet/Hayır) yapmalı; mevcut uygulamalar 31 Ocak 2027'ye kadar. Yeni uygulamalar doğrulanmadan Çin'de yayınlanmaz.
